ModMetaData.name: RimWorld MCP
ModMetaData.author: Kemal Asliyuksek
ModMetaData.description:
Lets AI assistants such as Claude Code see your running game through the Model Context Protocol, so you can ask "what should I do next?" and get an answer based on your actual colony.
It can also find you a place to settle: describe what you want, and it searches the world, ranks tiles by the shape of their predicted mountains and moves the camera to its favorite.
It can explain your ideoligion options and set one up for you, and find or edit your starting colonists, if you ask. You review the result and press Next yourself.
It never touches the game's code or files. During play it only observes and reports what you can see yourself, so unexplored areas and hidden information stay hidden.
It adds no defs and needs no other mods, leaves nothing in your save files, and can be added to or removed from an ongoing game.
